arabic text: NA AB HUSSAIN NA LASHKAR HUSSAIN KA HOGA\nSITAM UTHAANE KO BIMAAR E KARBALA HOGA
english translation text: NO LONGER WILL HUSSAIN AND HIS ARMY BE THERE (TO PROTECT WOMEN AND CHILDREN)\nALONE WILL BE SAJJAD (BEMAAR-E- KARBALA) TO BEAR ALL THE PAIN

arabic text: PATAKTI HONGI SAR APNA FURAT KI MAUJE\nDHUAN JALE HUWE KHAIMON SE UTHH RAHA HOGA
english translation text: WAVES OF RIVER FURAT MUST BE REPENTANT NOW (TO HAVE NOT AIDED THE HOLY FAMILY)\nCAMPS MUST BE ON FIRE NOW, SPREADING SMOKE ALL AROUND

arabic text: NA AB HUSSAIN NA LASHKAR HUSSAIN KA HOGA
english translation text: NO LONGER WILL HUSSAIN AND HIS ARMY BE THERE (TO PROTECT WOMEN AND CHILDREN)

arabic text: ZAMINE GARM PE TASHNA DAHAN PADE HONGE\nSARON PE AB KOI SAAYAA NA REH GAYA HOGA
english translation text: THIRST STRICKEN HOLY FAMILY (OF AHLULBAYT) NOW LAYS ON HOTTEST OF GROUNDS\nNO SHELTER (NO SUPPORT), NOTHING OF COMFORT CAN BE FOUND ANYMORE

arabic text: KISI NE BAALIYAAN KAANON KI CHHINLI HONGI\nKOI TAMAACHE SAKINA KO MAARTA HOGA
english translation text: SAKINA BLEEDS NOW WITH HER EARRINGS SNATCHED (BY THE ENEMY)\nAND SHE BEARS THE PAIN OF GETTING SMACKED (BY THE ENEMY)

arabic text: ASIR HOKE NABI ZAADIYAAN CHALI HONGI\nTO DIL KA HAAL KHUDA JAANE KYA HUWA HOGA
english translation text: DISTRESSED AND DETAINED, DAUGHTERS OF PROPHET (S.A.W) TRAVELLED (TO SHAAM)\nONLY GOD KNOWS HOW THEY SURVIVED (THE UTTER PAIN)

arabic text: LAHU SHAHIDON KA DEKHA JO HOGA ZAINAB NE\nTO DIL SE PYAAS KA EHSAS MIT GAYA HOGA
english translation text: WATCHING THE BLOODSHED OF MARTYRS ALL AROUND\nZAINAB WOULD HAVE FORGOTTEN HER THIRST

arabic text: PADE HAI LAASH KE TUKDE KATE HAI BAAZU BHI\nMAGAR SAKINANE PEHCHAAN TO LIYA HOGA
english translation text: THE BODY HAS BEEN SCATTERED & SLASHED AND ARMS HAVE BEEN SEVERED\nBUT SAKINA WOULD HAVE SURELY RECOGNIZED (HER UNCLE ABBAS)

arabic text: ABHI NASIB MEN DURRE HAI AUR TAMAACHEN HAI\nABHI SAKINA KO PAANI KAHAAN MILAA HOGA
english translation text: BEATING AND WHIPPING IS ALL THAT IS LEFT IN (SAKINA’S) FATE\nHER THIRST HAS YET TO BE QUENCHED

arabic text: TUMHAARI PYAAS TO NAAWAKSE BUJGAYI ASGHAR\nDILE RABAB MAGAR GHAM SE HUK RAHA HOGA
english translation text: A SHARP ARROW HAS PUT AN END TO YOUR THIRST, O ASGHAR!\nRUBAB’S HEART (ASGHAR’S MOTHER) MUST BE SINKING, GOD KNOWS BETTER!

arabic text: ABHI SUKUN MUNAWWAR KAHAAN YATIMON KO\nABHI TO QAIDE MUSIBAT KA SAAMNA HOGA
english translation text: IT’S NOT AN END TO THE PAIN OF THE MASOOMS JUST YET\nAS MORE DISTRESS AND CAPTIVITY AWAITS THEM
